say:3:1520808001:1.text: These tracks... they're paw prints of <style="highlight">wild wolves</style>. They're fresh too.

say:4:1520808002:1.text: And the sun's setting. The wolves will start hunting soon.
say:4:1520808002:1.source_cn: 天快黑了，丛林里的野狼马上就要出来活动了……

say:7:1520808003:1.text:
Exactly.
Your punishment, Grift and Oboe, is to survive the night in this wolf-infested forest.
say:7:1520808003:1.source_cn: 没错。\n在野狼出没的丛林里度过一夜，这就是费斗和欧布...

say:8:1520808004:1.text: Remember, a Wildborn warrior's blade must never turn against their comrades, only against enemies. That will be your lesson!
say:8:1520808004:1.source_cn: 雅库伯尔战士的刀刃和箭矢只能面向敌人，决不允许指向同伴...

say:9:1520808005:1.text: But there are too many wolves here! Just the two of us can't possibly...
say:9:1520808005:1.source_cn: 可是丛林里的野狼那么多，只靠我和欧布两个人根本对付不了！

say:10:1520808006:1.text: Then use what you've learned! Traps, stealth, ambush tactics. Everything I've taught you.
say:10:1520808006:1.source_cn: 运用你们学到的技巧！陷阱，躲藏，埋伏。该用的都用上。

say:11:1520808007:1.text: Or are you telling me that Wildborn warriors hoping to fight in the Bloodhunt Festival are going to cower before a few wolves?
say:11:1520808007:1.source_cn: 雅库伯尔的战士难道会因为区区几只野狼就退缩？

say:13:1520808009:0.text: But if... if Grift and I prove ourselves tonight, then by tradition, we should be rewarded.
say:13:1520808009:0.source_cn: 如果……如果我和费斗证明了自己，按照雅库伯尔的规矩，我...

say:14:1520808010:0.text: Oh? And what do you want?

say:15:1520808011:0.text: ...I don't want anything from you, Father.

say:18:1520808012:0.text: O Great Herdmaster, I humbly request... if we survive and prove our worth, grant us a weapon as our prize!
say:18:1520808012:0.source_cn: 伟大的兽群之主，我恳求您……赐予我们一把武器，作为胜者...
say:18:1520808012:0.male: O Great Herdmaster, I humbly request... if we survive and prove our worth, grant us a weapon as our prize!
say:18:1520808012:0.female: O Great Herdmaster, I humbly request... if we survive and prove our worth, grant us a weapon as our prize!

say:20:1520808013:0.text: Silence! How DARE you make demands of the Hunting God!
say:20:1520808013:0.source_cn: ——闭嘴！你怎么敢向狩猎神提要求！
say:20:1520808013:0.male: Silence! How DARE you make demands of the Hunting God!
say:20:1520808013:0.female: Silence! How DARE you make demands of the Hunting God!

say:21:1520808014:1.text: If the Herdmaster will witness our trial, then I want to earn his approval!
say:21:1520808014:1.source_cn: 和猎血节无关，既然狩猎神大人要用<male>他</ma...
say:21:1520808014:1.male: If the Herdmaster will witness our trial, then I want to earn his approval!
say:21:1520808014:1.female: If the Herdmaster will witness our trial, then I want to earn her approval!

say:22:1520808015:1.text: Great Herdmaster, I'm not asking for a divine weapon. I'll win that myself at the Bloodhunt Festival.
say:22:1520808015:1.source_cn: 狩猎神大人，我不祈求您赐予附有神力的武器。我会等到猎血...
say:22:1520808015:1.male: Great Herdmaster, I'm not asking for a divine weapon. I'll win that myself at the Bloodhunt Festival.
say:22:1520808015:1.female: Great Herdmaster, I'm not asking for a divine weapon. I'll win that myself at the Bloodhunt Festival.

say:23:1520808016:1.text: All I ask for is proof—something that shows we are worthy of your attention!
say:23:1520808016:1.source_cn: 这次，我只希望得到一个证明！
say:23:1520808016:1.male: All I ask for is proof—something that shows we are worthy of your attention!
say:23:1520808016:1.female: All I ask for is proof—something that shows we are worthy of your attention!

choice_prompt:24:1520808016.text: All I ask for is proof—something that shows we are worthy of your attention!
choice_prompt:24:1520808016.source_cn: 这次，我只希望得到一个证明！
choice_prompt:24:1520808016.male: All I ask for is proof—something that shows we are worthy of your attention!
choice_prompt:24:1520808016.female: All I ask for is proof—something that shows we are worthy of your attention!

say:26:1520808018:1.source_cn: ……既然狩猎神答应你了，我没有意见。

say:27:1520808019:1.text: But still, a weapon blessed by the Herdmaster is a divine gift. It must be presented properly—at a blessing ceremony witnessed by the entire Wildborn tribe!
say:27:1520808019:1.source_cn: 但赐予武器是兽群之主的神恩，必须在赐福仪式上，让整个雅...
say:27:1520808019:1.male: But still, a weapon blessed by the Herdmaster is a divine gift. It must be presented properly—at a blessing ceremony witnessed by the entire Wildborn tribe!
say:27:1520808019:1.female: But still, a weapon blessed by the Herdmaster is a divine gift. It must be presented properly—at a blessing ceremony witnessed by the entire Wildborn tribe!

say:29:1520808020:1.text: No problem! I'll take down every last wolf!
say:29:1520808020:1.source_cn: 那有什么问题？我现在就去解决那些野狼，保证一只都不留！

say:30:1520808021:1.text: Father... I will prove to you that I'm worthy of the Herdmaster's blessing!
say:30:1520808021:1.source_cn: 阿爹……我会证明给你看的，我有能力得到狩猎神的恩赐！
say:30:1520808021:1.male: Father... I will prove to you that I'm worthy of the Herdmaster's blessing!
say:30:1520808021:1.female: Father... I will prove to you that I'm worthy of the Herdmaster's blessing!

say:35:1520808023:1.text:
They've gone deep into the forest now.
Kordan... aren't you a bit worried?
say:35:1520808023:1.source_cn: 他们进入丛林了。\n戈丹，不担心吗？

say:36:1520808024:1.text: No. They've trained for this moment.
say:36:1520808024:1.source_cn: 不，他们已经训练很久了。

say:37:1520808025:1.text: But what about weapons? Do they have enough arrows?
say:37:1520808025:1.source_cn: 那么，武器呢？他们的武器可能不够。

say:39:1520808027:0.text: If they can't use it properly, then they're clearly not mature enough to receive the Herdmaster's blessing.
say:39:1520808027:0.source_cn: 如果他们不会利用，那就证明他们还不够成熟，没有得到兽群...
say:39:1520808027:0.male: If they can't use it properly, then they're clearly not mature enough to receive the Herdmaster's blessing.
say:39:1520808027:0.female: If they can't use it properly, then they're clearly not mature enough to receive the Herdmaster's blessing.

choice_prompt:41:1520808027.source_cn: 如果他们不会利用，那就证明他们还不够成熟，没有得到兽群之主赐物的资格。
choice_prompt:41:1520808027.male: If they can't use it properly, then they're clearly not mature enough to receive the Herdmaster's blessing.
choice_prompt:41:1520808027.female: If they can't use it properly, then they're clearly not mature enough to receive the Herdmaster's blessing.

say:43:1520808030:1.text: Now we wait. We'll have our answer at dawn.
say:43:1520808030:1.source_cn: 现在，我们只需要等待明早的结果。

say:44:1520808031:1.text: Hunting God, what weapon will you bless them with? Should I have our artisans prepare something special?
say:44:1520808031:1.source_cn: 狩猎神，你要赐福他们什么武器？需要让工匠提前准备吗？
say:44:1520808031:1.male: Hunting God, what weapon will you bless them with? Should I have our artisans prepare something special?
say:44:1520808031:1.female: Hunting Goddess, what weapon will you bless them with? Should I have our artisans prepare something special?

choice_prompt:45:1520808031.male: Hunting God, what weapon will you bless them with? Should I have our artisans prepare something special?
choice_prompt:45:1520808031.female: Hunting Goddess, what weapon will you bless them with? Should I have our artisans prepare something special?

say:46:1520808032:1.text: Perfect! The <style="highlight">artisans of Wrathwood Grove</style> will be deeply honored!
say:46:1520808032:1.male: Perfect! The <style="highlight">artisans of Wrathwood Grove</style> will be deeply honored!
say:46:1520808032:1.female: Perfect! The <style="highlight">artisans of Wrathwood Grove</style> will be deeply honored!

choice:45:0:1.text: I'll choose a weapon from the armory.
choice:45:0:1.source_cn: 从现有的武器里选一把就行
choice:45:0:1.male: I'll choose a weapon from the armory.
choice:45:0:1.female: I'll choose a weapon from the armory.

choice:45:1:2.text: Take me to see the artisans.
choice:45:1:2.male: Take me to see the artisans.
choice:45:1:2.female: Take me to see the artisans.

say:48:1520808029:1.text: She is my daughter after all.
say:48:1520808029:1.male: She is my daughter after all.
say:48:1520808029:1.female: She is my daughter after all.

choice:41:1:2.text: You're not worried what might happen to Oboe?
choice:41:1:2.source_cn: 你一点也不担心欧布会出事？
choice:41:1:2.male: You're not worried what might happen to Oboe?
choice:41:1:2.female: You're not worried what might happen to Oboe?

choice:24:0:1.text: Alright, I'll grant you a weapon.
choice:24:0:1.source_cn: 好吧，那我就赐予你们一把武器
choice:24:0:1.male: Alright, I'll grant you a weapon.
choice:24:0:1.female: Alright, I'll grant you a weapon.

choice:24:1:2.text: You've got some guts, I'll allow it.
choice:24:1:2.source_cn: 敢向我提要求，很有胆量，可以
